intent.caption: Rich empty state — An empty-state panel that is rich, never void (DL16): guidance copy, ghost preview, one accent action.

textContent.text: Commissioned pieces and saved references will appear here once you begin.

visualSpec.effects: Panel 3.2w x 2.2h scene units, corner radius 0.06, filled with a radial engineered gradient #14141a (at 0.0, center) -> #0b0b10 (at 1.0, edges) plus a hairline grid at 0.25-unit pitch (1x base) in #e8ecf2 at 6 percent opacity so the region is never void; 0.006-unit hairline border #26262f; ghost preview at left of center: a wireframe watch-card outline 1.1w x 1.4h drawn in 0.008-unit strokes of #e8ecf2 at 30 percent opacity containing a ghost dial circle 0.55 diameter and two ghost text bars 0.7w x 0.06h at 22 percent; ghost group breathes opacity 0.24 -> 0.34 over 2400ms cubic-bezier(0.445,0.05,0.55,0.95) yoyo repeat; copy column right of the ghost with 0.5-unit padding (2x base), headline then body on a 0.25 baseline rhythm; accent CTA 1.5w x 0.36h below the body, vertical gradient #ff4450 -> #c1121f, ink label, edge emissive #ff2a38 intensity 1.5, press scale 1.0 -> 0.97 over 120ms cubic-bezier(0.175,0.885,0.32,1.275); mount fade-up opacity 0 -> 1 and y +0.2 -> 0 over 500ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); the key light grazes the panel so the hairline grid catches faint specular structure, keeping depth in an intentionally empty region.
